subject: physics

hotspots.label: Battery Case
hotspots.description: The jacket that holds the chemical layers safely inside.
hotspots.function: Holds and protects the internal layers.

hotspots.label: Chemical Layers
hotspots.description: The stacked reactants whose reaction stores and releases the energy.
hotspots.colorHint: Cutaway showing pale amber and grey strata.
hotspots.function: Store the chemical energy that becomes the push.

hotspots.label: − Terminal
hotspots.description: The flat end where electrons pile up, ready to leave.

hotspots.label: + Terminal
hotspots.description: The nipple end that pulls electrons back — the two ends' difference is the volts.
hotspots.function: Accepts electrons returning through the loop.

hotspots.label: Circuit Switch
hotspots.description: Closes the loop so the battery's push can drive current to the bulb.
hotspots.colorHint: Small amber lever on the wire run.
hotspots.function: Connects the battery to the bulb.

hotspots.label: Usage Knob
hotspots.description: Simulates draining the cell; the layers shrink and the bulb dims.
hotspots.colorHint: A round dial labeled with a draining arrow.
hotspots.function: Demonstrates the cell being used up.

visualStyleNotes: Warm off-white paper ground, soft vignette. A standing cutaway cell showing pale strata, brass jacket, amber + nub, dark − cap, and a small bulb beside it.
materialNotes: Cutaway faces: matte textured layers (roughness ~0.7); jacket metallic-roughness with metallic ~0.5, roughness 0.4; terminals smooth.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: battery anatomy and its two ratings; visible drain.

GEOMETRY: a vertical cell (h≈1.0) with cutaway window showing layers; terminals +/−; a bulb + switch on a short loop; a usage dial.

INTERACTION: the switch closes the loop and lights the bulb; the usage knob lowers layer thickness and dims the glow; a mAh/voltage label updates.

NAMED NODES: Case, Layers, NegCap, PosNub, LoopSwitch, UsageDial. 7-10k tris.
